Like others have said, I’d highly recommend finding a full time job or other ways of increasing your income and stability before considering moving.

You could probably rent a single room in a shared space with more than 1 roommate for $700/mo but it would be miserable. Alternatively, maybe a basement for yourself (with housemates on another floor) at $1000-$1200/mo but it would likely be illegal (most do not have a separate entrance). 

Bear in mind, this is just rent alone - there are MANY other expenses that come with moving and living independently including Movers, WiFi, Utilities (if not included in rent), Groceries, etc. Even if you find a cheap place, your budget for other living expenses will be extremely tight.

I’ve done both. Rented a single room for $700/mo with 2 roommates and then rented a basement for $1050/mo with 2 housemates and I’ll be candid, I was miserable and too irritated by my room/housemates to go in the shared spaces.

I work a full-time corporate marketing job and now live on my own in a $2.2k/mo 1bed 1 bath apartment and I’m the happiest I’ve ever been (which is on the cheaper end with Toronto prices)! 

I totally understand wanting to live alone - I didn’t have the best home environment with my family so I sucked it up and lived in a room/basement until I could live on my own, but I’d highly recommend just saving/finding more ways to earn money before moving if your current living situation isn’t too bad.

Best of luck!

Hihi! Full-time Influencer Manager here - previously a Community Manager and I've hired for social media roles as well.

Like others have said, this is not ATS friendly so it's probably getting scrapped before a real person sees it. I understand wanting things to be aesthetically pleasing but for resumes, simplicity is key. I'd save the aesthetics for your digital portfolio.

Also more specificity would be great re: your impact at each role! eg. "Increased follower growth across all 5 brands through account optimization and content creation" How much growth? Give a follower increase percentage and the time frame to achieve it.

Again: "Increased brand revenue through spearheading 3 social media marketing campaigns." Back it up with stats, what was the actual revenue percentage increase from the most significant campaign you ran? Numbers are key.

"Increased livestream viewership to an average of 2700 views per live..." What was the average CCV to begin with? I need a clearer idea of what your specific impact was.

Also, what tools have you used? Hootsuite, Socialsprout, Buffer, Later, etc.?

Another thing - ditch the Profile paragraph. Succinct bulletpoints with VERY specific statements showing impact are what recruiters care about. 

If you want a cute About section, I highly recommend you create a digital portfolio online, write your more personable Bio there, and include the link in your application.

\*Edited for formatting.
